goal: Build a reproducible empirical map linking non-neural edge-evidence families, aggregation families, and error/benefit profiles, then use that map to make prospectively justified improvements to strong non-neural edge detectors and validate the frozen best method across multiple datasets under matched scientific protocols.
final_inference_constraint: No neural network, pretrained neural feature extractor, neural embedding, or neural postprocessor may appear in the final Stage-23 candidate inference path.
primary_questions: Which descriptor/evidence families provide complementary information rather than redundant responses?
Which aggregation properties best exploit different kinds of complementarity?
Can descriptor-aggregator relationships learned on development-authorized data predict useful interventions in strong non-neural detector architectures?
Do the resulting improvements transfer across literature-comparable validation protocols and multiple external datasets?

cache_contract.rule: For an exact dataset/split/image/preprocessing/descriptor-or-transform/parameter/implementation identity, compute once and reuse the persisted artifact in every later stage.

development: UDED selection under the existing leakage-free policy
BSDS500 validation under the existing official-evaluation policy
other author-designated validation/development splits preregistered before inspection
protected_final: any newly reserved untouched final/external split
dataset_policy.rule: Protected/final outcomes may be reported after freezing but may not choose descriptors, aggregators, parameters, architecture, routing, thresholds, or experiment priority.

publication_protocol.rule: For methods intended for scientific comparison, research and use the author-designated validation/development split and matched evaluator whenever available; keep literature headline test numbers separate from local matched-protocol validation results.
publication_protocol.after_selection: Freeze the best improved method and run it unchanged on several diverse datasets/protocols, including at least one genuinely untouched external/final evaluation when feasible.

campaign_order: 23C one-time UDED descriptor extraction and individual baselines
23E bounded descriptor x aggregator UDED landscape
23G gap-guided improvement of strong non-neural detectors
23H freeze best improved method and run multi-dataset generalization
selection_principles: Do not assume Choquet is best; compare representative alternative aggregation families and simple controls under identical evidence inputs.
Prune by redundancy/complementarity before higher-order combinations; do not run unrestricted descriptor powersets.
Individual descriptor weakness does not automatically imply removal if the descriptor contributes unique GT-supported true positives.
Record precision, recall, F1, ranking/AP behavior, localization, calibration/score-scale behavior, and stability where the protocol supports them.
Preserve negative results because the scientific product is a landscape of interactions, not only a winning model.

When improving a strong detector, reproduce it first, diagnose its existing evidence and gaps, choose a missing complementary evidence family, and choose aggregation prospectively from the already observed Stage-23 interaction map.

autonomy_policy.normal_mode: Use medium reasoning for routine completed experiments.
autonomy_policy.research_mode: Use high reasoning plus live web search for descriptor/aggregator census, protocol verification, strong-detector selection, and unresolved mechanism questions.
autonomy_policy.human_blockers_only: credentials/license/payment, protected-lineage edits, unsafe external actions, or irreducible methodology ambiguity

success_criteria: The descriptor and aggregator census is grounded in primary literature and official code/protocol sources.
The cache system is certified before large extraction and later stages reuse persisted artifacts without silent re-extraction.
The descriptor-aggregator landscape is bounded, reproducible, and reports complementary behavior rather than only a scalar winner.
At least one literature-comparable validation track confirms whether the UDED-derived interaction principles transfer.
Any claimed improved strong detector is compared against its baseline under the same matched protocol.
The final selected method is frozen before multi-dataset external/final reporting and is not tuned from those outcomes.
stop_conditions: the user explicitly stops the campaign
a hard external blocker requires human credentials/license/payment
a protected scientific-lineage change is necessary but forbidden
an irreducible ambiguity would invalidate the scientific claim and cannot be resolved from provenance/literature/code
